taste:
These wings combine a crisp exterior with tender, juicy chicken and a spicy coating that leaves lingering heat. Tanginess is part of the seasoning too, so the flavour is not simply about chilli intensity. The contrast between the crisp outside and softer meat is central to the dish, which is described as served piping hot.

A choice of cool blue cheese or garlic dip adds a creamy contrast between bites. Neither changes the character of the wings themselves: this remains a heat-led option rather than a mild chicken dish. The generous portion suits sharing, though it is also presented as a hearty meal for one.
